verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an endpoint that suggests extraction schemas for a given file, which is a narrow form of AI-generated suggestions derived from the user's own document. It also documents running published agent processors on a document. The rest of the product is document conversion and extraction, not insight generation. Missing for 10: any documented AI insights or analysis of document content, suggestions surfaced in the Forge UI rather than only via API, detail on what agent processors produce, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: For a given file, generate potential extraction schemas.
Run a published agent processor on a document.
